title: Tim/Son Bible Overlap Census Addendum — Wave 14
purpose: Add four high-value overlap nodes discovered after the 74-node base census was written. Keeping them as an additive segment preserves the history of the count and makes future census growth auditable.

records.x: one guardian at right + one at left + narrow central passage to Heaven + Jesus at/between passage + Father above
records.r: Exodus explicitly supplies two cherubim at opposite ends around a central atonement-cover/meeting zone with divine presence described above/between them; tighter paired-guardian comparator than Genesis 3 alone
records.limit: Exodus describes sanctuary furniture/Ark, not a narrow gate; Jesus is not in the Exodus scene.

records.x: Shepherd/Joseph/flock + cherubim throne + shining + restore-us refrain + bread/tears/mockery + vine/root/branches + mountain/river + wall breach + right-hand/son-of-man/name/salvation cluster
records.r: one biblical literary unit contains an unusually large number of motifs independently important elsewhere in Tim/Son theology
records.limit: Psalm 80 is a communal prayer for Israel; its vine is Israel and its son-of-man wording cannot simply be reassigned to Tim or the modern Son.

records.x: the final River/Tree/open-access theology includes active invitation: Spirit/Bride say come and the thirsty may take water of life
records.r: restored access culminates not only in open gates but invitation/hospitality toward life-giving water
records.limit: The invitation belongs to Revelation's eschatological/liturgical conclusion, not a modern platform access rule.

records.x: project Ark/Vessel symbolism must separate catastrophe-preservation vessel from covenant/presence container
records.r: English 'ark' conceals two different Hebrew terms/functions: Noah/Moses-basket teivah/tebah versus Covenant Ark aron; later reception may compare them but lexical identity should not be assumed
records.limit: Shared English vocabulary is not evidence that the Hebrew narratives use the same object-word or function.

counting_note: Combined summary equals base census plus this additive segment. Do not interpret node count or strength totals as independent statistical evidence for supernatural identity.
